2026-11-05.intro: This came with the update of 5 November 2026.

ticketConfirmation.title: A ticket is finished by both sides
ticketConfirmation.body: When the eGrant team marks a ticket “Solved on our side”, its author confirms it or sends it back. Without an answer, it is resolved automatically after 5 days.

ticketAssignment.title: Assignees are set automatically
ticketAssignment.body: A client’s account owners become the assignees of every new ticket. Automatic assignees by area and the notifications about a client’s new tickets are gone, and a project replaces the programme.

2026-10-21.intro: This came with the update of 21 October 2026.

taskSplit.title: Tasks from a text with AI
taskSplit.body: The task board has a new button, “Generate tasks from text”. Paste or type a text, AI proposes tasks from it, and you review and edit them before they are created.

snippets.title: Saved replies with a slash
snippets.body: In Settings, under “Saved replies”, prepare the replies you often write, and share them with colleagues if you like. In a chat or a ticket, just type / and pick a reply.

bulkEmail.title: Container in bulk email
bulkEmail.body: The “Container” block has a “Simple” layout (one area of blocks) or a “Split” one (two columns). You can give it rounded corners, a background colour and inner space.

finance.title: Salaries and contracts in Finance
finance.body: Salaries have their own records in the “Salaries” view (admin, month, amount, files), and the old salary expenses moved there. Contracts can have a master contract, an amount of 0 and a payment schedule with “Expected payments”; you can link documents to a contract, a salary or an expense.
